HOPE is a unique interdisciplinary pediatric neurological rehabilitation center in the middle east starting in Dubai, United Arab emirates.

Hope is not just a Rehabilitation Center it is an Abilitation one. Abilitation is the concept of empowering young individuals with disabilities to reach their best possible unexplored potential along the spectrum of their physical, occupational, speech, and cognitive needs.

Hope caters for all the various state of the art rehabilitation techniques invented worldwide under one roof. Also catering for both therapy models of intensive therapy camps and long term continuous therapy serving children in various age groups differently.

Most important core competency will be integrating various techniques with the understanding that individualized programs work best, tailoring a comprehensive and individualized custom made plan that will suit each individual specifically.
